features: 2 white LEDs with selectable night modes
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states 5MP, wired PoE, IP66 metal housing, two-way audio, human detection, 2 white LEDs with selectable night modes and 9 English alarm sounds, and notes it is a separate listing from the 8MP TA-XM-605GP-AI-80N. Typed bullet from the page's own product photo. RTSP path from the QuarkView fixed PoE camera family manual linked on the page (main stream only; default user admin with an empty password, default IP 192.168.1.10); the same manual states ONVIF and RTSP support. Lens, field of view, frame rate, codecs, sensor and dimensions are not published.

frigate.notes: Main-stream path from the QuarkView fixed PoE camera family manual (Xiongmai platform). The manual does not document a sub-stream; on Xiongmai firmware it is usually stream=1.sdp, but confirm via ONVIF discovery before using it for detect. Set a password first: the factory password is empty.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration; the manual lists ONVIF support but not the ONVIF port.

blue_iris.notes: Add as a generic ONVIF/RTSP camera (Xiongmai platform).
